highlight.title: Blue Lights — Season 4
highlight.badge: BritBox Original · North America Premiere · November 12
highlight.description: The Belfast cop drama returns for a fourth season, following probationary officers turned seasoned cops Grace, Annie and Tommy as they navigate the city's paramilitary-linked crime. New episodes stream weekly.

new_arrivals.title: Blue Lights
new_arrivals.description: Grace, Annie and Tommy are back on the beat in Belfast for a tense new season balancing community policing with the city's paramilitary underworld.

new_arrivals.title: Death Valley
new_arrivals.description: Timothy Spall returns as semi-retired TV detective John Chadwick, roped back into real police work alongside DS Janie Mallowan for a new season of Welsh valley mysteries.

new_arrivals.title: Ludwig
new_arrivals.description: David Mitchell's puzzle-setter John Taylor closes out the season still working undercover as his missing twin brother, with the mystery of John's disappearance finally coming to a head.

originals.title: Happy Valley
originals.description: Sarah Lancashire won a BAFTA for her portrayal of West Yorkshire police sergeant Catherine Cawood, among other honours. Intense, perfectly written, and utterly unmissable.

originals.title: Trigger Point
originals.description: Vicky McClure is magnetic as explosives officer Lana Washington. Each series is a taut, gripping thriller with real stakes and superb performances.

originals.title: Beyond Paradise
originals.description: A warm, character-driven spin-off of Death in Paradise, following Kris Marshall's Humphrey Goodman as he settles into life in Devon and Cornwall.

originals.title: The Other Bennet Sister
originals.description: A new drama inspired by the world of Jane Austen, focusing on Mary Bennet, the overlooked middle sister of Pride and Prejudice, as she forges her own path.
